title: Dheedhi Hair Care Herbal Shampoo Cheevakka & Thulasi

details.description: Dheedhi Herbal Shampoo combines Ayurvedic heritage with modern science. It nourishes the scalp, softens strands and strengthens roots, with kattarvazha, cheevakka, nellikka, brahmi and thulasi.
details.ingredients: Indian aloe, Soap pod, Holy basil, Indian gooseberry, Thyme, Coconut oil
details.usageInstructions: 1. Apply to wet hair and scalp. 2. Leave on for 1 to 2 minutes and wash off with water.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Keep out of reach of children.
